# Elyxian Dental & Smile Studio

> Premier patient-first dental clinic located in Lajpat Nagar, South Delhi, offering general dentistry, cosmetic smile design, dental implants, orthodontics, root canal treatment (RCT), and pediatric dental care.

## Treatments & Services

- [General Dentistry & Teeth Cleaning](https://www.elyxianstudio.com/treatments/general-dentistry/): Routine dental check-ups, scaling and polishing, cavity fillings, and preventive gum care.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://www.elyxianstudio.com/treatments/cosmetic-dentistry/): Professional teeth whitening, composite bonding, and dental veneers for smile enhancement.
- [Dental Implants](https://www.elyxianstudio.com/treatments/dental-implants/): Permanent titanium tooth replacements for single, multiple, or full-arch missing teeth.
- [Braces & Clear Aligners](https://www.elyxianstudio.com/treatments/braces-and-aligners/): Orthodontic teeth straightening using modern clear aligners and fixed braces.
- [Root Canal Treatment (RCT)](https://www.elyxianstudio.com/treatments/root-canal-treatment/): Endodontic therapy to eliminate infection and relieve tooth pain while preserving the natural tooth.
- [Pediatric & Children's Dentistry](https://www.elyxianstudio.com/treatments/childrens-dentistry/): Gentle, friendly dental care for children from infancy through the teenage years.

## The Patient Experience
At Elyxian Dental, every first visit follows a structured 5-step approach:
1. **Pre-visit confirmation:** Appointment details and guidance sent via WhatsApp or phone call.
2. **Conversation first:** Discussion of patient history, concerns, and questions while seated upright.
3. **Examination & imaging:** Clinical examination with digital imaging only when clinically indicated.
4. **Transparent options:** Clear explanation of findings, treatment choices, and timelines without pressure.
5. **Written plan:** Patient receives a written overview to review before any elective treatment starts.

## Emergency Dental Care
For emergency toothaches, knocked-out teeth, or urgent trauma, visit https://www.elyxianstudio.com/book.html#emergency for step-by-step first aid guidance and direct clinic contact.
